respuestas.texto: Yeah its me you ugly pice of wood
I dont have time for this

monologo: I heard that you were given your inherited position again. Dammit! That means the carpenter and blacksmith work together again.

respuestas.texto: Thats right and Im going to need a steady, good, cheap flow of wood.
Blacksmith and carpenter together, what joy. Wait, just kidding

monologo:
Dont let the fumes go up, blacksmith. I, too, received a letter from the king.
Youre just going to be in your beautiful blacksmith shop, Ill have to provide pre-assembled constructions for the camps.
If youre going to want my sticks and shields, I need you to do some things for me first.
Take this scheme, my circular saw broke and I need a new one. Bring it to me and Ill see what I can do for you.

respuestas.texto: Im not going to work for you.

monologo:
Why are you taking so long? 
Is my saw ready? 
You dont know how to do something so simple and you want to supply an army?

respuestas.texto: I still need time damn carpenter

monologo: Welcome to the only good commerce officially recognized by the king

respuestas.texto: I come to buy sticks and branches, show me
